title: Your opinion
subtitle: A view you formed recently, and why
intro: Sobriety gives you back a clear head. Use it. Think of something you recently made up your mind about — big or small.

fields.label: What shaped it — an experience, a conversation, something you read?
Would you have seen it the same way while drinking?

title: Appreciate yourself
subtitle: Three things you did right this week
intro: You don't need anyone's permission to give yourself credit. Small counts.

title: Flip the self-talk
subtitle: Catch a harsh thought and rewrite it
intro: The voice that says you're weak isn't giving orders, it's giving noise. Catch one line and rewrite it the way a good sergeant would.

title: Map a trigger
subtitle: Where, when, who, and your exit plan
intro: Know the terrain before the fight. Pick one situation that reliably pulls at you.

fields.label: Where and when does it happen?
What do you feel right before the urge?

title: Three good things
subtitle: What went right in the last 24 hours
intro: Your brain is wired to scan for threats. Train it to spot wins too.

title: Letter to future you
subtitle: Write to yourself, one year sober
intro: Picture yourself a year from today, still holding the line. What do you want that person to know about right now?

title: Values check
subtitle: Did today line up with what matters?
intro: Name what you stand for, then hold today up against it.

fields.label: A value that matters to you
Where did today line up with it — or not?
One move tomorrow to live it more

title: Count a small win
subtitle: Something you'd have skipped before
intro: Big victories are built from small ones nobody else sees.

title: Urge autopsy
subtitle: Break down your last craving
intro: Every urge you survived holds intel. Debrief the most recent one.

fields.label: What did the urge tell you?

title: Who's in your corner
subtitle: Name your backup
intro: Nobody holds the line alone. Take stock of your unit.

fields.label: One way you'll lean on one of them this week

title: Set a boundary
subtitle: Decide it before you need it
intro: A boundary decided in advance is far easier to hold than one made up under pressure.

title: Prep a hard conversation
subtitle: Plan the words, not just the dread
intro: Unspoken conflict is fuel for cravings. Get the words ready.

title: Body check-in
subtitle: Sleep, energy, and what your body needs
intro: Hungry, angry, lonely or tired make every urge louder. Run the scan.

fields.label: What does your body need today?

title: Spend the spoils
subtitle: Put the money you've saved to work
intro: Check your savings tally. That money is yours now — give it a mission.

fields.label: What will you do with it?

title: Name a fear
subtitle: Drag it into the light
intro: Fears grow in the dark. Write one down and size it up.

fields.label: What you'd actually do if it happened

title: Forgive a mistake
subtitle: Talk to yourself like a friend would
intro: Carrying shame is heavy gear. Set one piece down.

fields.label: What you'd say to a friend who made it

title: Sober fun list
subtitle: Things you enjoy with a clear head
intro: Sobriety isn't just subtraction. Build the list of what you're adding.

fields.label: Which one this week, and when?

title: Remember your why
subtitle: The reasons you enlisted
intro: On hard days the reason matters more than the rules. Write yours down again.

fields.label: Who you're doing it for (including you)

title: Lesson from a setback
subtitle: Turn a bad day into intel
intro: Every commander studies the battles that went wrong. Pick a rough moment and debrief it.

title: Who you're becoming
subtitle: Describe the sober version of you
intro: Write about the person you're turning into as if it's already true.

title: Do one kind thing
subtitle: Get out of your own head
intro: Helping someone else is one of the fastest ways to quiet a craving.

fields.label: Who will you help, and how?
How did it go? (fill in later)

title: Then vs now
subtitle: Measure how far you've marched
intro: Compare a typical day before you stopped with a typical day now.

title: Plan the weekend
subtitle: Scout the risky hours ahead
intro: Unplanned free time is where many slips happen. Put a plan on the map.

fields.label: Who you'll call if it gets hard

title: Question for your sponsor
subtitle: Bring it to your next call
intro: Your sponsor has walked this road. What do you want to ask?
